name: RenderStateFlags
meaning: Bitmask passed to Render_SetStateFlags (0x4155F0) and Render_ClearStateFlags (0x4159B0). Each bit maps to one or more IDirect3DDevice7 SetRenderState / SetTextureStageState calls. Values decoded from the D3DRENDERSTATETYPE numbering (SRCBLEND=19, DESTBLEND=20, CULLMODE=22, ALPHAREF=24, ALPHAFUNC=25, DITHERENABLE=26, ALPHABLENDENABLE=27, FOGENABLE=28, SPECULARENABLE=29, LIGHTING=137, COLORVERTEX=141, CLIPPLANEENABLE=152).

name: RSF_BLEND_ALPHA
meaning: ALPHABLENDENABLE=1, SRCBLEND=INVSRCALPHA(6), DESTBLEND=SRCALPHA(5) — note the inverted-alpha convention

name: RSF_ZWRITE_OFF
meaning: ZWRITEENABLE=0 (then ZENABLE=1 if the call succeeded); the clear path writes ZWRITEENABLE=1

name: RSF_ZWRITE_ON
meaning: ZWRITEENABLE=1 (then ZENABLE=1 if the call succeeded); the clear path writes ZWRITEENABLE=0

name: RSF_TEXTURED
meaning: stage 0: TEXCOORDINDEX(0xb)=0, COLORARG1(2)=TEXTURE(2), COLORARG2(3)=DIFFUSE(0), COLOROP(1)=MODULATE(4). When clear, the set path instead writes COLORARG1=DIFFUSE, COLOROP=SELECTARG1(2) (untextured). The clear path writes COLOROP=DISABLE. Verified in 0x4155f0; the first call is TEXCOORDINDEX, not ALPHAARG2 (stage state 6).

name: RSF_FILTER_LINEAR
meaning: stage 0: MAGFILTER(0x10)=MINFILTER(0x11)=LINEAR(2); cleared to POINT(1). Verified in 0x4155f0 and 0x4159b0; ADDRESSU/ADDRESSV (stage states 13/14) are never written.
